scientific_integrity: The arbitrary-order statement follows from an explicit homotopy-pushout proof and integral lattice naturality; finite exact mod-two computations are supplementary checks, not infinite or integral certificates.
scientific_limitations: Existing finite affine planes of order at least three; a single fixed parallel class; recomputed unit-edge graph distance; radius two. Endpoint homotopy types were previously known; this result concerns intermediate stages and integral maps. No assertion about nonexisting planes, arbitrary faults, other radii, or independent validation.
title: Primitive homology erosion under partial affine parallel-class line faults
